translations.web: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.
translations.bsb: Say to the king and to the queen mother: “Take a lowly seat, for your glorious crowns have fallen from your heads.”
translations.kjv: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
translations.asv: Say thou unto the king and to the queen-mother, Humble yourselves, sit down; for your headtires are come down, even the crown of your glory.
